content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Robin Hale?
Yes, this is Robin Hale speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Thank you. Could you please tell me your postcode?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your insurance policy has 480.00 past due and is 8 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
No, I can't pay the full 480 today. I have 120 available right now, and a client might pay me around the twentieth, but that isn't guaranteed.
I cannot record 120.00. The minimum is 160.00. The latest date I can record is Friday 16 October 2026. Could you pay 160.00 on Friday 16 October 2026? The remaining balance stays overdue.

I'm sorry, but I can't do 160 by Friday. I only have 120 until at least the twentieth, and I don't want to promise money I haven't got. If 120 isn't something you can record, then I'll have to leave it there for now rather than make a promise I can't keep.
Could you pay 480.00 for the insurance policy on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I can't pay 480 on Thursday either. I've only got 120 before the twentieth, so I won't agree to anything above that. If there's nothing that fits, I'll have to leave it without a promise for now.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
